page.overview:
Who is Pevara Tazanovni?

Pevara Tazanovni is an Aes Sedai and a former Sitter of the Red Ajah.

Pevara is a pretty woman with large dark, twinkling eyes, short black hair and a merry face., Pevara Tazanovni|Pevara}} She is "pleasingly plump", stout and 5'4" or 163 cm in height. Her personality is cheerful, and she has a ready smile. She does not dislike men, as many Red Sisters do; instead, her devotion to her Ajah comes from her belief that gentling male channelers is a way for her to challenge the Shadow to the best of her abilities.

Pevara has a One Power strength of , making her very strong for an Aes Sedai. Only four other women out the Tower loyalists we have details on can match her strength, and only Elaida exceeds it.}} She is weak in Earth.

She is capable of opening a Gateway and possesses the Talent of Healing. Seaine Herimon notes she was very good at hunting down men who can channel.
